narratives.label: Active-dispatch fault.
narratives.description: With active control enabled, an external input becomes abnormal or a controlled device develops a fault.
narratives.impact: Active-power control is disabled; plant active output may consequently miss the utility's requirements.

narratives.label: Reactive-dispatch fault.
narratives.description: With reactive control enabled, an external input becomes abnormal or a controlled device develops a fault.
narratives.impact: Reactive-power control is disabled; plant reactive output may consequently miss the utility's requirements.

narratives.label: Grid-point AC breaker open.
narratives.description: SmartLogger detects that the main grid-point AC breaker is open.
narratives.impact: Grid export stops, all inverters shut down, and SmartLogger disables power control.

narratives.label: Cubicle-device fault.
narratives.description: A cubicle dry contact changes state during the Japanese relay joint test.
narratives.impact: This is a reported relay-test result; other services are unaffected.

narratives.label: Duplicate device address.
narratives.description: The Modbus TCP forwarding address assigned to SmartLogger duplicates a connected device's address.
narratives.impact: SmartLogger's forwarding address defaults to 0. An address collision prevents forwarding the affected device's data over Modbus TCP.

narratives.label: AC surge-protector fault.
narratives.description: In a communications-box installation, the dry contact reports a failed surge protector.
narratives.impact: Lightning protection is unavailable, exposing SmartLogger to storm damage.

narratives.label: User-configured alarms for DI1–DI8.
narratives.description: A peripheral presents an abnormal dry-contact indication to SmartLogger.
narratives.impact: The peripheral may be faulty and may affect system operation.

narratives.label: 24 V supply fault.
narratives.description: In a communications-box installation, the dry contact reports failure of the internal 24 V supply.
narratives.impact: Loss of supply prevents the communications-box weather sensor from operating normally.

narratives.label: WebUI-server certificate invalid.
narratives.description: The WebUI certificate is dated to become valid in the future.
narratives.impact: The source reports no operational impact.

narratives.label: WebUI-server certificate nearing expiry.
narratives.description: The WebUI certificate is approaching expiry.
narratives.impact: The source reports no operational impact.

narratives.label: WebUI-server certificate expired.
narratives.description: The WebUI certificate has expired.
narratives.impact: The impact cell supplies no additional consequence (NA).

narratives.label: Licence nearing loss of entitlement.
narratives.description: Licence status: (1) its entitlement certificate is in the grace period; (2) its licensed function will soon become unavailable.
narratives.impact: The licensed feature will soon become unavailable.

narratives.label: Management-system certificate invalid.
narratives.description: The management-system certificate is dated to become valid in the future.
narratives.impact: Connection to the management system is unavailable.

narratives.label: Management-system certificate nearing expiry.
narratives.description: The management-system certificate expires in 60 days.
narratives.impact: The management-system connection will be lost after 60 days.

narratives.label: Management-system certificate expired.
narratives.description: The management-system certificate has expired.
narratives.impact: Connection to the management system is unavailable.

narratives.label: SmartLogger certificate invalid.
narratives.description: The SmartLogger certificate is dated to become valid in the future.
narratives.impact: The impact cell supplies no additional consequence (NA).

narratives.label: SmartLogger certificate nearing expiry.
narratives.description: The SmartLogger certificate expires in 60 days.
narratives.impact: Continued use of a connection after certificate expiry presents a security risk.

narratives.label: SmartLogger certificate expired.
narratives.description: The SmartLogger certificate has expired.
narratives.impact: Continued use of a connection after certificate expiry presents a security risk.

narratives.label: One or two Smart Rack Controller DC-bus cables disconnected.
narratives.description: The description cell supplies no additional explanation (NA).
narratives.impact: A Smart Rack Controller with an abnormal DC-bus connection cannot operate.

narratives.label: One or two Smart PCS DC-bus cables disconnected.
narratives.description: The description cell supplies no additional explanation (NA).
narratives.impact: A smart battery controller with abnormal DC-bus cables cannot operate.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: The black-start command sequence or timing is incorrect.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: The array's current operating state does not satisfy black-start prerequisites.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: No ESS is available for the operation.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: The ESS lacks black-start support.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: The PCS lacks black-start support.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: The ESS black-start attempt failed.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: No PCS is available for the operation.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: Array black-start failure.
narratives.description: The PCS black-start attempt failed.
narratives.impact: The array does not complete black start.

narratives.label: ESS shutdown after STS switch-off.
narratives.description: An ESS component fault triggers ESS shutdown.
narratives.impact: A fault causes the ESS to shut down.

narratives.label: Array-topology inconsistency.
narratives.description: The topology generated by SmartLogger is abnormal.
narratives.impact: The generated topology is invalid and some systems cannot operate normally.

narratives.label: ESS startup-control failure.
narratives.description: ESS control is abnormal.
narratives.impact: Battery-compartment startup failure prevents normal ESS operation.

narratives.label: PCS parameter mismatch.
narratives.description: PCS VSG parameters and PCS GFM parameters are inconsistent within the subarray.
narratives.impact: PCS parameter mismatches cause abnormal operation.
